function_summary: Metal DC gearmotor with quadrature encoder for mobile robots.
classification_reason: Vendor explicitly describes mobile-robot drive use; other joint mechanisms require separate structure and control.
assembly_notes: One gearmotor with encoder; wheel, mount, driver and power separate.
evidence_note: Introduction identifies integrated encoder, gearbox and mobile-robot application; shipping list contains one motor.

function_summary: TT geared DC motor with quadrature feedback for controlled robot motion.
classification_reason: Vendor mobile-robot application supports locomotion; alternative joint use is only a component-level suggestion.
assembly_notes: One motor plus motor/encoder cables; wheel, controller, motor driver and frame separate.
evidence_note: Description identifies a geared motor for mobile projects; shipping list specifies motor and two cables.

function_summary: Standard hobby servo for controlled angular movement.
classification_reason: Vendor cites head, arm and biped use, so primary arms with optional head/legs is supported at joint level.
assembly_notes: One servo; links, bearings, mounts and command/power system are separate.
evidence_note: Introduction explicitly lists head, arm and biped applications; shipping list is one servo.

function_summary: Lightweight micro servo for small mechanisms and angular positioning.
classification_reason: Small arm or pan-tilt head joints fit the vendor examples; it is not a full arm or load-bearing leg.
assembly_notes: One micro servo; external structure, power and control needed.
evidence_note: Description lists small robotic arms and pan-tilt mechanisms and limits use to light-duty rotation.

function_summary: Dual-channel TB6612FNG breakout controls two small brushed DC motors.
classification_reason: Driver electronics enable movement but are not the moving limb itself.
assembly_notes: Driver board and two headers; motors, host and power separate.
evidence_note: Introduction identifies two motor channels and shipping list includes the breakout plus headers.

function_summary: L298N dual H-bridge controller regulates direction and speed of two brushed motors.
classification_reason: Control electronics serve locomotion or manipulation; neither physical assembly is supplied.
assembly_notes: One motor controller; motors, host controller and supply separate.
evidence_note: Description specifies two brushed motors with PWM speed and direction control.

function_summary: ESP32-E programmable controller board with wireless communication and battery charging.
classification_reason: Internal compute and communication functions belong to support, not structural torso.
assembly_notes: Board and listed pin headers; battery, sensors and actuators separate.
evidence_note: Introduction identifies main-controller function and onboard charging; shipping list contains board and headers.

function_summary: Compact TF-Luna single-point time-of-flight lidar measures object range.
classification_reason: Range perception suggests a head component; single-point sensing is not a full scanning head.
assembly_notes: Sensor module; host, suitable wiring and physical mounting required.
evidence_note: Introduction identifies a single-point solid-state lidar using time of flight.

function_summary: BNO055 orientation module fuses accelerometer, gyro and magnetic sensing.
classification_reason: Body orientation feedback is internal support rather than outward perception.
assembly_notes: One sensor board with headers; not a mechanical head or torso.
evidence_note: Introduction describes absolute orientation and fused quaternion/Euler outputs; shipping list lists sensor and headers.

function_summary: Tracked mobile chassis with motors and suspension for ground travel.
classification_reason: Tracks supply the robot locomotion role represented by legs, despite the included body frame.
assembly_notes: Platform kit; ultrasonic sensor and control board are explicitly excluded.
evidence_note: Vendor describes a tracked mobile platform and explicitly excludes ultrasonic sensor and control board.

function_summary: Four 80 mm mecanum wheels support omnidirectional mobile robots.
classification_reason: Ground-contact wheels are locomotion parts, not a complete powered base.
assembly_notes: Two left and two right wheels; motors, hubs, chassis, power and controller separate.
evidence_note: Shipping list specifies two left and two right wheels, with left/right installation markings.

function_summary: Dual 18650 holder with charging and regulated power outputs.
classification_reason: Stores cells and manages supply for robot electronics; it is not a battery cell or body segment.
assembly_notes: Holder/charging module only; shipping list does not include 18650 cells.
evidence_note: Description identifies two-cell accommodation and charging outputs; shipping list contains one battery box.
